en.title: Anya Taylor-Joy and Octavia Spencer Lead New Streaming Thrills This Weekend
en.summary: This weekend's streaming lineup offers a mix of high-stakes thrillers and action-packed comedies, featuring star power from Anya Taylor-Joy and Octavia Spencer.
en.body:
This weekend, the streaming landscape is serving up a potent blend of mystery and action, perfect for those looking to settle in for a cinematic escape. Apple TV+ introduces **Lucky**, starring the ever-captivating **Anya Taylor-Joy** as a con woman on the run after a daring heist. While early reviews suggest it might not be a runaway critical success, Taylor-Joy's presence on screen, coupled with the promise of clever set pieces and the always-welcome addition of **Timothy Olyphant**, makes it a worthy consideration for fans of stylish thrillers. The series aims to deliver suspense with a dash of flair, even if the critical reception has been mixed.

Meanwhile, Prime Video is bringing the heat with **Ride or Die**. This action-comedy pairs the formidable talents of **Octavia Spencer** and **Hannah Waddingham** as two new friends whose burgeoning relationship takes a sharp turn when one discovers the other is an international assassin. The premise alone promises a wild ride, and with the added enticement of globetrotting sequences and explosive car chases, this project seems to have invested heavily in production value. The chemistry between Spencer and Waddingham is sure to be a highlight, offering a fun, high-octane adventure.

For those who prefer to stick with their established streaming services, **The Amateur** is now available on Disney+. **Rami Malek** stars as a CIA cryptographer seeking revenge after his wife is killed in a terrorist attack. The film boasts the formidable presence of **Laurence Fishburne** as his trainer, suggesting a solid foundation for a revenge thriller. The premise is classic, tapping into the primal urge for justice, and with Malek and Fishburne at the helm, it’s poised to deliver a compelling narrative.

## The Appeal of High-Stakes Storytelling

These new releases tap into a timeless fascination with intricate plots and compelling characters. Whether it's the intricate web of a con artist's escape in **Lucky**, the unexpected danger lurking in a new friendship in **Ride or Die**, or the raw pursuit of vengeance in **The Amateur**, these stories promise to keep audiences on the edge of their seats. The inclusion of celebrated actors like **Anya Taylor-Joy**, **Octavia Spencer**, **Hannah Waddingham**, **Rami Malek**, and **Laurence Fishburne** elevates these offerings, drawing viewers in with the promise of stellar performances and expertly crafted narratives.

## What's Next

Looking beyond this weekend's immediate thrills, the literary world is already anticipating a strong 2026. Notable upcoming releases include **Leila Slimani**'s **I'll Take the Fire** and **Maggie O'Farrell**'s **Land**. Also on the horizon are **Jenny**'s **The Shampoo Effect** and **Alice Oseman**'s highly anticipated **Heartstopper Volume 6**. These titles suggest that compelling storytelling across various genres will continue to captivate readers in the coming year.

tr.title: Bu Hafta Sonu İzlenecek Yeni Dizi ve Filmler: Anya Taylor-Joy ve Octavia Spencer
tr.summary: Bu hafta sonu, Apple TV+ ve Prime Video gibi platformlar, Anya Taylor-Joy ve Octavia Spencer gibi ünlü oyuncuların yer aldığı yeni dizi ve filmlerle dolu bir hafta sonu vaat ediyor. İzleyiciyi heyecanlandıracak aksiyon ve gerilim dolu içerikler, bu hafta sonu ekranlara geliyor.
tr.body:
Bu hafta sonu, izleyiciyi heyecanlandıracak yeni dizi ve filmler ekranlara geliyor. Apple TV+, **Lucky** adlı yeni dizisiyle dikkat çekiyor. Dizide, her zaman etkileyici performanslarıyla dikkat çeken **Anya Taylor-Joy**, bir soygunun ardından kaçan bir dolandırıcıyı canlandırıyor. Erken eleştiriler, dizinin tam bir eleştirel başarı olmayabileceğini öne sürse de, Taylor-Joy'un ekran karşısındaki varlığı ve **Timothy Olyphant**'ın dizide yer alması, stil sahibi gerilim severler için bu diziyi mutlaka izlenmesi gereken bir yapım haline getiriyor. Dizi, gerilimi şık bir şekilde sunmayı amaçlıyor vemixed eleştirilere rağmen izleyiciyi etkilemeyi hedefliyor.

 Prime Video ise **Ride or Die** adlı yeni filmiyle izleyiciyi aksiyon dolu bir maceraya davet ediyor. Film, **Octavia Spencer** ve **Hannah Waddingham**'ın oynadığı iki yeni arkadaşın hikayesini anlatıyor. Bu iki arkadaş, uluslararası bir suikastçı olan diğer arkadaşını keşfettiklerinde hayatları tamamen değişiyor. Film, coşkulu bir macera vaat ediyor ve globetrotting sekansları ve patlayıcı araba kovalamacaları ile üretim değerine yatırım yapmış görünüyor. Spencer ve Waddingham arasındaki kimya, izleyiciye keyifli ve yüksek oktanlı bir macera sunuyor.

 ## Yüksek Tehlike Hikayelerinin Tadı
 Bu yeni yayınlar, karmaşık plotlar ve çekici karakterlerle ilgili zaman dışı bir fascinasyona dokunuyor.Ya **Lucky**'deki bir dolandırıcının kaçışının karmaşık ağı, **Ride or Die**'deki yeni bir arkadaşlıkta beklenmedik tehlike veya **The Amateur**'deki intikam arayışı, bu hikayeler izleyiciyi koltuğunda tutmayı vaat ediyor. **Anya Taylor-Joy**, **Octavia Spencer**, **Hannah Waddingham**, **Rami Malek** ve **Laurence Fishburne** gibi ünlü oyuncuların yer alması, bu içerikleri daha da çekici hale getiriyor ve izleyiciye üstün performanslar ve uzmanca hazırlanmış hikayeler vaat ediyor.

 ## Gelecek
 Bu hafta sonu için immediate heyecanların ötesine baktığımızda, 2026 yılı edebiyat dünyası için güçlü bir yıl vaat ediyor. Yaklaşan yayınlar arasında **Leila Slimani**'nin **I'll Take the Fire** ve **Maggie O'Farrell**'in **Land** gibi önemli eserler yer alıyor. Ayrıca **Jenny**'nin **The Shampoo Effect** ve **Alice Oseman**'ın çok beklenen **Heartstopper Volume 6** da yakında yayınlanacak. Bu eserler, çeşitli türlerdeki hikayelerin önümüzdeki yılda okuyucuları etkilemeye devam edeceğini gösteriyor.

content_raw: A mystery lover’s guide to what’s new to streaming this weekend. ___________________________________ New and Returning Mystery and Thriller Series __________________________________ Lucky (Apple) This new series on Apple features Anya Taylor-Joy as a con woman on the run following a heist. (Please don’t confuse this with the short-lived David Milch show, Luck . Just kidding, I know nobody was going to make that mistake; I just wanted a chance to remind you that show exists, and was actually pretty good! But, I mean, serious issues with the horses.) The show has some star power, and Taylor-Joy is always watchable on screen, with some clever set pieces to push her through. The early reviews are pretty underwhelming, so if you need more enticement to give it a shot, I’ve saved pivotal information for last – also starring Timothy Olyphant. Ride or Die (Prime) This action comedy stars Octavia Spencer and Hannah Waddingham as a pair of new friends, just happily going through the early stages of their relationship, when one of them discovers the other is an international assassin. And I’ll give you one guess who the next assassination target is. Spencer and Waddingham are a fun pair and there’s a lot of value going into production on this one, with some satisfying globetrotting and big old car chases. ___________________________________ Movie Night ___________________________________ If you’re looking to stream from one of your usual services this weekend, consider The Amateur (Disney), starring Rami Malek as a CIA cryptographer who loses his wife to a terrorist attack and convinces the higher-ups to train him into a lethal weapon so he can go extract his revenge. Laurence Fishburne is doing the training, so you’ve got a pretty nice duo at the top. It’s all based on the Robert Littel novel. If you’re willing to pony up some cash for VOD, you’ll have a couple more options. First, you might want to check out Backrooms , another of the big horror breakout films of the year, from a very young director with an impressive YouTube pedigree and some good stars on board. The other choice, and honestly this one’s probably my choice, is Normal , starring Bob Odenkirk who’s lately been making an unlikely turn as an action star. Here he plays the new cop in Normal, Minnesota, a seemingly idyllic town that erupts into all-out war, with the new lawman in town standing dead center. Odenkirk brings volumes of humanity to every role he plays, and he manages the same trick here, balancing some pretty entertaining shootout work with the subtleties of his everyman-with-a-soul performance. Plus 5 new additions to the streaming libraries… Fargo (1996) (Netflix) Capote (2006) (Prime) Ronin (1997) (Prime) The Magnificent Seven (1960) (Prime) The Bling Ring (2013) (Tubi)
